title: Provider prior-authorization intake
description: Allow providers to submit a complete traceable prior authorization request
acceptance_criteria: Submission is validated idempotent and creates an evidence-bound Change Case

title: Evidence packet and human review
description: Assemble coverage clinical-document and policy evidence for licensed reviewer consideration
acceptance_criteria: Evidence is versioned and a licensed human records the determination

title: Reversible authorization-release canary
description: Release the portal workflow progressively with telemetry-driven pause and rollback
acceptance_criteria: Promotion has provenance telemetry gates and a tested rollback path
